builds.hypothesis: R1 grants20% totalAD; maximum R2=600+1.65 bonusAD physical from missingHP. AD/armor penetration support cone; crit does not multiply R. kitEvidence.formula:
Riven's weapon surges with spiritual energy, granting her [(0.2) × AD] Attack Damage and increased range on damaging Abilities and Attacks for [15] seconds. While active, she can Recast.

Recast: Riven fires a wind slash that deals between [100 / 150 / 200 + (0.55) × AD[statFormula=2]] and [300 / 450 / 600 + (1.65) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage, based on their missing Health.

builds.name: Broken Wings: three slashes under Blade of the Exile
builds.summary: Investigate high one complete three-slash Broken Wings sequence output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one complete three-slash Broken Wings sequence output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Each Q slash deals 45/75/105/135/165 + 0.6/0.65/0.7/0.75/0.8 bonus AD physical. Rank-5 three-hit nominal total is 495 + 2.4 bonus AD if all three connect. R1 grants AD based on 20% of total AD; read actual post-buff bonus AD rather than multiplying the final Q total by 1.2.
